description: Messages holding a variable-length value longer than its enclosing Set: a one-octet length of 5 with 4 octets left, and a three-octet length of 1000. The Template Set and the first record of each message are valid; the RFC has the collector discard the message. The well-formed message after them is read.
deviation: rustflow keeps both messages, reporting the Data Set as undecoded octets, where RFC 7011 section 9.1 has the collector discard a message with such a length.
